rapport_notes: Nicole is warm, patient, and handles customer clarifications gracefully (parking garage contingency, driveway access); professional and reassuring throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Repeated minimum time / 2.5-hour framing twice in Stage 1 (once when answering agenda, again during logistics). Did not hold silence after 'Does that make sense so far?' or after the close.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: "I just need about ten to fifteen minutes is now a good time? ... By the way, what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things he wants answers to on this call today?"
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: "By the way, what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things he wants answers to on this call today?" — asked before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'mostly interested in minimum time.' Nicole answered with rate structure but did NOT ask follow-up like 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is on your mind' — pivoted directly to logistics.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: "We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages." (Stage 2, as part of differentiator pitch.)
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: "A few days before the move, you will be receiving an email introducing the movers to you will have an option to see their photo and basic info." (Stage 2, as part of differentiator pitch.)
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: "We have on time guarantee if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill." (Stage 2.)
evidence_quotes.communication: "You will be receiving an email introducing the movers ... just helping is detention of strangers arriving at your front door." (Stage 2 — email intro of crew, but no day-before call or named crew lead mentioned.)
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: "For a typical one bedroom apartment it usually takes around two and a half to three and a half hours to completely move-in your case since you're moving from a first floor apartment with a long walk moving to a one story house, I estimate this move to take around three and a half to four and a half hours."
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit_to_rate: "We will be charging you for the total time consumed by the end of the move." (Establishes rate accountability.)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: "Keep in mind, this is just an estimate we will be charging you for the total time consumed by the end of the move." (Estimate framed as a window.)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it: "Once we go over the minimum the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments." (Implies discount if under, but not explicit 'if we beat it you pay less' phrasing.)
evidence_quotes.close_fail: Nicole ends with 'We're open everyday from 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM and do you have any questions or anything for me?' — no rate-lock line and no explicit ask like 'would you like our help with your move?'

top_strength: Nicole nailed the quid pro quo and asked the agenda question first, before any logistics probing, establishing clarity on the customer's priorities early.
coaching_note: Follow up on the customer's stated concern (minimum time) with a second layer question — 'tell me more about that' or 'what else matters to you' — before pivoting to logistics; and close with the rate-lock line and an explicit ask to book.
